raw_segments.text: While the direction was being executed, the lady consulted moved slowly up the room.
I suppose I have a considerable organ of veneration, for I retain yet the sense of admiring awe
with which my eyes traced her steps.
See now, in broad daylight, she looked tall, fair, and shapely.
Brown eyes with a benignant light in their ear-ids, and a fine penciling of long lashes
round, relieved the whiteness of her large front.
On each of her temples her hair of a very dark brown was clustered in round curls, according
to the fashion of those times, when neither smooth bands nor long ringlets were in vogue.
Her dress, also in the mode of the day, was of purple cloth, relieved by a sort of Spanish
A gold watch—watches were not so common then as now shown at her girdle.
Let the reader add, to complete the picture, refined features—a complexion, if pale,
clear, and a stately air and carriage—and he will have at least as clearly as words
can give it—a correct idea of the exterior of Miss Temple, Maria Temple, as I afterwards
saw the name written in a prayer-book entrusted to me to carry to church.
